prompt: In the rewind/checkpoint picker, a condensed checkpoint that spans multiple sessions can display an empty prompt even though one of its sessions did record a usable prompt. This happens when the most recent session was recorded without a prompt. Make the picker surface a usable prompt from an earlier session instead of showing nothing. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: session prompts most recent versus earlier
how checkpoint prompt is chosen for display
reading all session prompts from checkpoint tree
_subject: rewind picker: fall back to earlier prompt in multi-session checkpoints
